scripts.zip: python3 -c "import zipfile, os, shutil; zip_path='shopease-project.zip'; exclude={'node_modules', '.git', 'dist', '.cache', '__pycache__', '.temp'}; z=zipfile.ZipFile(zip_path, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED); [z.write(os.path.join(r, f), os.path.relpath(os.path.join(r, f), '.')) for r, d, files in os.walk('.') for f in files if not any(x in r for x in exclude) and not f.endswith('.zip')]; z.close(); os.makedirs('public', exist_ok=True); shutil.copy(zip_path, 'public/shopease-project.zip'); print('shopease-project.zip generated successfully')"
